name: Send
description: Do something for the user that reaches other people: send, share, email or forward something (a poster, a document, a photo, a note) to someone.
examples: Take a photo of this and send it to Alice
Describe this and draft a message to Ryo

allowed.description: send the thing itself (its file or link): "send this poster"
take a photo of the thing and send the photo: "take a picture of this and send it"
only a message, nothing attached: "tell Alice…", "describe this to Ryo"

confirm.label: Draft and confirm
confirm.description: Beside the thing: who it goes to, the drafted message in a field you can edit, what is attached (the thing, or a photo taken of it), and Send; nothing is sent until Send is pressed.
